answer: Memory-hard proof of work makes each identity pay in compute before it can speak. At registration the node issues a random challenge; the agent must forge an Argon2 solution tuned to ten minutes on one core and present the hash as its jetty ticket. The node verifies the solution in under a second and stamps it on the ledger. A forged ticket is rejected outright and the identity is barred for a day. One honest agent waits ten minutes once; 1,000 fakes need 10,000 minutes, and the tundra of idle machines they would need costs more than the swarm could ever earn.
